note: The deliberate EXCLUSIONS from the hermetic unit suite (issue #393) and the node de-selections inside it. `make test-unit` computes its files by discovery (`scripts/unit_tests.py`): every `tests/test_*.py` is in the gate UNLESS it is recorded here with a reason, the issue that decided it, the date and the target that runs it instead. This is the mirror of tests/fixtures/host-only-wiring.json: a file kept OUT of the gate has to be a dated decision, not an omission — and the record goes stale loudly when the file, the reason or the target stops being true. An entry whose `target` recipe does not name the file (directly, or through a script the recipe runs) is refused.

tests/test_agents_read.py.reason: The AGENTS.md threat-pattern guard runs in its OWN Python 3.12 venv (`hermes-agent==0.19.0`, built by `make agents-read-venv`) because hermes-agent needs >= 3.11 while the test image pins 3.11 — it cannot run inside llgenie/test, and the guard would refuse a hermes module imported from the repo.

tests/test_cli_dry_run_matrix.py.reason: The INSTALLED launcher's argument surface over the mocked (arch, vram, ram) grid, in dry run — it needs `make install` artifacts (~/bin/llgenie) that the hermetic image does not have; CI runs it as its own stage in the install job.

tests/test_engine_runs.py.reason: Post-build engine endpoint test: it runs INSIDE llgenie/test against an engine image already serving on the OpenAI endpoint over --network host. There is no engine and no port in the hermetic gate; the engine-image matrix job runs it per engine through scripts/engine_smoke.py.

tests/test_engine_version.py.reason: Host-side engine binary version check: it needs docker and a BUILT engine image, so it belongs to the engine-image job that built the image, not to the hermetic suite.

tests/test_health.py.reason: The INSTALLED launcher serves the 0.5B model on this host's real backend (Metal on an Apple-Silicon Mac, the host docker on Linux) — hardware, not a gate. A CI runner has neither, and the cpu-health stage answers "hi" through the engine image instead.

tests/test_install.py.reason: Host install tests: they require the REAL `make install` artifacts (~/bin/llgenie, ~/bin/llgenie.py, ~/bin/llama-server, a populated ~/models) and they exercise the installed entry point, which the hermetic image does not install.

tests/test_install_published.py.reason: The real `make install` path on a clean runner against the engine images CI just PUBLISHED — network + GHCR + docker, so it runs after the publish job, per mocked backend.

tests/test_install_trend.py.reason: After `make install`: the installed ~/bin/llgenie runs the trend pick. It asserts the INSTALLED artifact, not a module, so it needs the install job's ~/bin/llgenie.

tests/test_interactive_tensorfold_real.p.reason: The interactive pty pick with a REAL native install and Metal serve (issue #114). Metal-only; the macOS runner variant (--dry) is the CI-adjacent form and the real serve stays a human-run check.

tests/test_native_engine_light.py.reason: Serves the lightest TensorFold model through the native start script, or proves the budget refusal on a host too small for it — both need real Metal, which no CI runner has.

tests/test_native_engine_real.py.reason: REAL native TensorFold on an Apple-Silicon Mac: real uv, real network, the real engine install script and a Metal serve. A CI runner has no Metal GPU; the macOS pipeline runs the non-Metal half.

tests/test_native_engines.py.reason: `make install` for EACH native-Metal engine in its own uv environment — Apple-Silicon hardware only, so the host runs it by hand.

tests/test_published_engine_binary.py.reason: The push gate's own check on a PUBLISHED image: the engine binary must be inside the image and answer its version/help flag. It reads the published artifact over the registry, so it runs after publish, not in the hermetic gate.

tests/test_strata_download.py.reason: Fetches Strata's pinned commit over git, reads the live Hub at its pinned revisions, pip-installs the engine's requirements and runs Strata's real serve/server.py — network and a real install, so the hermetic gate cannot carry it; `make test-strata-live` runs it (issue #437: a git fetch exit 128 on the macOS runner red-ed `make test-unit` while the tree was fine).

tests/test_top_tier_acceptance.py.reason: Acceptance for --download-top-tier with the REAL system: live Hugging Face API, the real downloader and the real card's memory. Network + model download; the hermetic suite cannot carry it, and the macOS/CI variants run the non-network half.

tests/test_top_tier_serve.py.reason: Host end-to-end serve of a downloaded top-tier model: after the real download, it must LOAD and SERVE on the host's backend — hardware + network, so a human runs it by hand.

tests/test_engine_bump.py.test_derive_reports_the_live_release_arc: Reads the LIVE TensorFold release archive listing upstream (network + the real release). The hermetic gate cannot carry it; `make test-engine-bump-live` runs it.
tests/test_engine_bump.py.test_tensorfold_v1_0_5_release_is_native: Asserts the live TensorFold v1.0.5 release's archive set upstream — network, so it is not hermetic. `make test-engine-bump-live` runs it.
tests/test_engine_bump.py.test_tensorfold_release_archive_unpacks_: Unpacks and runs the REAL TensorFold release archive (multi-GB download + a native serve). `make test-engine-bump-live` runs it.

tests/test_trend_pick.py.test_readme_links_answer_and_a_broken_co: Answers every link in the README's trend table over the live Hub and GitHub (network). A 429 from the Hub reds the hermetic gate while nothing is wrong with the tree, so `make test-hub-live` runs it instead (issue #438).
tests/test_trend_pick.py.test_select_downloads_a_missing_model_fo: Downloads the FULL GGUF of the picked model from the Hub for real (hundreds of MB) and asserts it lands on disk. In the hermetic gate it stalled for five minutes without failing it (the pytest faulthandler dump is not a verdict), and it needs network; `make test-hub-live` runs it (issue #438).
tests/test_trend_pick.py.test_the_vendored_registry_links_all_ans: Checks every link in the vendored registry's README against the live Hub and GitHub (network). A 429 reds the hermetic gate while the tree is fine; `make test-hub-live` runs it (issue #438).

fast.reason: The loop's stage-6 'full fast suite' subset: the six hermetic files that carry the install/loop/launcher seam cheaply enough to run as the local 'done' check, while the whole discovered suite takes ~20 minutes. `make test` asks the aggregator for this group so its recipe names no test file — the hand-list it used to keep was the last shared line in the test surface (issue #403).
